name: Sylvera
description:
Sylvera's mission is to help the world meet the Paris goals by scaling the carbon markets. We do this by providing the data that lets the market work.

Sylvera combines its proprietary, and carbon accounting data with in-depth knowledge of best practice in project design, to provide uniquely data-driven insights into offset project quality.


For Nature-Based projects, Sylvera’s advanced geospatial technology allows us to detect, and flag, any changes in nature-based solutions projects as and when they happen.
